data.contenido:
Ki kiyookto malaikaiyat ne kiguure Gabriel kwo konyor kwondo ne kararan ne kiguuren Maria. Kilenji malaikaiyandonoto Maria sichei lakwet ne tun egu laitoriat koigeny. Ki kisigyi Jesu moinget ak koruteechi eng’ yoto mestowek. Ki ye ibata nito, kondochi kecheiyat anan kogelye bik che ki bunu Kong’asis koba ole mi lakwanoto. Kinetigei kora agobo chito ne ki yae bichuto kogeer kecheiyat ak ole kigisorundo Jesu eng’ bik che ki machei kobar.

Ne rubei, kinetigei agobo kong’alaldos Jesu ak konetik eng’ hekalut kingo bo kenyisiek 12. Kingobata kenyisiek tamanu ak sisit, kibatisan Jesu ak konaam boisiet ne kigaiyook Jehovah konyo koyai eng’ ng’ony, noto ko koamda ak konet bik logoiywek che miach che bo Bounatet. Ki lewen anyun murenik 12 koek che kiyooktoi si kobiit kotoret eng’ boisionichoto.

Ki yai Jesu kwong’utik che chang’ kora. Ki baee bik che chang’ samaginik ak magatinik tutigin. Kiisoob bik che ki miandos ak kong’eet che kigobek. Kit ne bo let ne kinetigei, ko tuguk che chang’ che kiyaak betut ne bo let eng’ sobetab Jesu ak ole kigibarta. Ki amda Jesu kenyisiek che negit somok ak kebeberiat, ko u noto ko ng’alalee KEBEBERTAB 6 kasartab kenyisiek che siirei 34.

KIGUURE kwonyi kararan Maria. Maria ko cheptab Israel ago menyei nganasetab Nasaret. Ingen Kamuktaindet kole Maria ko chi ne mie. Noto amu nee si koyook malaikaiyat ne kiguure Gabriel konyo kong’alalji. Tos ingen kit ne nyo komwachin Gabriel Maria? Ngegeer.

Kiigat Gabriel Maria kole: ‘Chamgei inye ne i chamat mising’. Mi Jehovah koboten.’ Tomo kogeerei Maria chichi besio. Kiigochi ng’alechuto Maria koarogen amu ma nai amu nee si kemwachi ng’alechu. Kogaigai anyun Gabriel Maria sainoto.

Kolenji Gabriel: ‘Mearogen Maria. Chamin Jehovah mising’. Noto amu nee si komache koyaun kit ne kararan ne bo kwong’ut. Isiche lakwet konegit ago nyolu iguure Jesu.’

Kotestai Gabriel komwa kole: ‘Egu lakwani chi ne o, ago tun kiguuren Weritab Kamuktaindet ne Toror Mising’. Tun yae Jehovah koek laitoriat ko u ole ki u Daudi. Nga u noto, ko tun egu Jesu laitoriat koigeny ago ma begu laitornatennyi!’

Koteeb Maria kole: ‘Imuktoi ano koyaak tuguchu tugul? Tomo kituno agot. Mangen muren, ara amuktoi ano asich lakwet?’

Kowol Gabriel kole: ‘Nyonjinin kimnatetab Kamuktaindet, ko u noto ko tun keguure lakwanato Weritab Kamuktaindet.’ Ki testai kolenji: ‘Ibwat tilyeng’ung’ Elisabet. Kimwa bik kole kigoyoosit ne magoi sich lakwa. Nga u noto, kosichei werit konegit. Kaigeer ile ma mi kiy ne ma imuchi koyai Kamuktaindet?’

Komwa Maria sainoto kole: ‘A otwogindetab Jehovah! Ingoyaak ko u ye kaimwa.’ Kingobata noto, kwo malaikaiyat.

Ki chakta anyun Maria kwo korutochi Elisabet. Kingo kas Elisabet kong’alali Maria, koureren lakwet eng’ moetab Elisabet. Konyonji tamirmirietab Jehovah Elisabet ak kolenji Elisabet Maria: ‘I ne iberurot mising’ eng’ kwonyik.’ Ki tebi Maria eng’ gotab Elisabet negit arawek somok, ak koweektagei gaa Nasaret.

Ki negit kotun chito ne keguure Josep Maria. Nga u noto, ko kingo nai Josep kole nyigis Maria, kobwat kole ma nyolu kotun. Kolenji malaikaiyatab Kamuktaindet Josep: ‘Ameiywei imut Maria koek kwondong’ung’. Amu Kamuktaindet ne koigochin werit.’ Kiitun anyun Josep Maria ak kogen kesich Jesu.Luka 1:26-56; Matayo 1:18-25. Teebutik che Kineetengei

TOS ingen ile ng’o lakwani ming’in? Kiguure Jesu. Kagisikyi ole kigerjin kiagik. Imogoni Maria Jesu eng’ moinget, moinget ko ole kindechin amitwogik sigirok ak kiagik alak si koam. Ara i, amu nee si komi Maria ak Josep ole mi kiagik? Tos nyolu kesikyi lakwet ole u yu iman?

Acha, ma nyolu. Mi yu bichuto amu kigon ng’atutiet laitoriatab Rom ne keguure Kaisari Augusto, kole magat koweektagei chi tugul nganaset ne kigisikyin si kobiit kesir kainennyi. Kigisikyin Josep yuto kiguure Betlehem. Kingoit Josep ak Maria Betlehem, ko ma nyor got ne tebeen. Ko yaach anyun kotebee ole mi kiagik, ago eng’ betunito kosich Maria Jesu! Agot inganda kagisikyi Jesu yuto, ko chamegei ko u ye igeere eng’ pichait.



Tos igeere mestowek che bwanei kogeerei Jesu? Kingo ta ko mi mestowechuto koribei kechirek kemoi, kogeer lapkeiyet ne o. Ki malaikaiyat! Koarogenso ne bo kwong’ut. Nga u noto, kolenji anyun malaikaiyat: ‘Amoarogense! Atinye logoiywek che miach che amache amwawok. Kagesich rani eng’ Betlehem Kristo, Kiptaiyat ne tun soru bik! Onyoru ko kagitae ngoroik ak kimogoon eng’ moinget.’ Kobwa sainoto malaikaisiek che chang’ ak konaam koloos Kamuktaindet. Ki chakta anyun mestowechuto ko ba kocheng’ Jesu, ago kagonyor ko u ye ibooru pichait.

Tos ingen amu nee si ko bo kamanut Jesu? Tos ingen ile ng’o inendet eng’ iman? Ibwat ile kiga king’alalee agobo Weritab Kamuktaindet eng’ atindoniot ne tai ne bo bukuini. Ki toretigei Werini ak Jehovah kingochobei kipsengwet ak ng’ony ak tuguk tugul. Jesu nito anyun!

Ki nam anyun Jehovah sobetab Werinnyin eng’ kipsengwet ak kouuto agoi moetab Maria. Ki eet anyun lakwanoto eng’ moetab Maria ko u ye eechegitu lagok alak eng’ mootinwekab kamatikwak. Nga u noto, ko ki Weritab Kamuktaindet lakwanito. Ki kisikyi anyun Jesu ole kigerjin kiagik eng’ Betlehem. Ka igeer amu nee si ko ki boiboi malaikaisiek komwachi bik kole kagesich Jesu?Luka 2:1-20. Teebutik che Kineetengei

TOS igeere kecheiyat ne ing’wereri bichu? Kureen bik alak kecheiyat kogelye. Kingomong’ bichu eng’ Jerusalem kotook kecheiyat. Bichu ko bunu Kong’asis ago ki somanji kecheik. Iyani kole indoochin kogelyani kot konyor chito ne bo kamanut. Kingoit bichuto Jerusalem koteeb kole: ‘Mi ano lakwet ka kile tun egu laitoriatab Yahudik?’ “Yahudik” ko kainet age ne bo Israelik. Komwa bichoto kole: ‘Kogigeer kecheiyatab lakwet kongemi Kong’asis, ago kagibwa si kobiit keoot inendet.’

Kingo kas Herod ne ki laitoriat eng’ Jerusalem ng’alechoto, koimgei ne bo kwong’ut. Ki ma ko machei konam chi age laitornatennyi. Ko u noto, koguur anyun Herod tisiik che eechen ak koteebe kole: ‘Kisikyin ano lakwet ne kiga kile egu laitoriat?’ Kowolji kole: ‘Mwae Bibilia kole Betlehem.’

Koguur anyun Herod bik che bunu Kong’asis ak kolenji: ‘Oba ak ocheng’ lakwanato mining’, ye onyoru omwowon. Amache awo ak ane aoot lakwanato.’ Nga u noto, ko eng’ iman ko ki machei Herod kobar lakwanato!

Kiindochi kecheiyandanato bichu agoi Betlehem ak kotonon eng’ ole ki mi lakwet. Ki ye chut go bichuto konyor Maria ak lakwet, Jesu. Kiigochi anyun bichuto konunotik Jesu. Nga u noto, ko ki ye ibata noto koteechi Jehovah eng’ karwotitoet bichoto kole mat koweek ole mi Herod. Ko u noto, kowektagei emennywa kobun oret age.

Ki ye nai Herod kole kagoweek olinnywa bikab Kong’asis, konerech ne bo kwong’ut. Ko u noto, kogoon ng’atutiet kebar werik tugul eng’ Betlehem che bo kenyisiek aeng’ ak koreg. Nga u noto, koteechi Jehovah Josep eng’ karwatitoet, ak kiimweito Josep bikab gonnyi koba Misri. Kingo nai Josep kole kigome Herod, koweekta Maria ak Jesu koba Nasaret. Ki eetunee anyun Jesu Nasaret.

Tos ibwati ile ki ng’o ne kiindochin kogelyanoto? Ibwat ile ki kaba bichoto Jerusalem korok kingogeer kogelye. Ki machei Setani kobar Weritab Kamuktaindet ago kiingen kole nyo kotieme Herod Laitoriatab Jerusalem kobar. Ko u noto, ko ki Setani ne ki yae kotook kecheiyandanato.Matayo 2:1-23; Mika 5:2. Teebutik che Kineetengei

LAKWANI igeere kong’alaljin boisiechu, ko Jesu. Boisiechuto ko konetik eng’ hekalutab Jehovah ne mi Jerusalem. Ki koeet Jesu ago nguni ko bo kenyisiek 12.

Ki kwong’io konetik ne bo kwong’ut amu kiingen Jesu tuguk che chang’ agobo Kamuktaindet ak tuguk che kigisir eng’ Bibilia. Ara amu nee si ma mi yuto Josep ak Maria? Tos mi ano? Ngegeer.

Imutu Josep kila kenyit bikab gonnyi kobwa igorto ne bo kamanut ne kiguure Paska ne kiyae eng’ Jerusalem. Loo keba kong’eete Nasaret agoi Jerusalem ago ma mi chi ne tinyei karit anan ko karitab mat amu ki ma ko mi tuguchoto betusiechoto. Bunei bik che chang’ kelyek ago yaachei kotar betusiek che negit somok si koit Jerusalem.

Kasari kotinyei Josep lagok che sere. Ko u noto, ko mi tupchosiekab Jesu che ta konyolu kerib. Mi banda ne loo Josep ak Maria koboto lagokwak koweeksei gaa Nasaret. Ibwati kole mi Jesu ak lagok alak. Nga u noto, ko ki ye imuuny koskoleny, ko nai kole ma mi Jesu koboto ichek. Ko cheng’ anyun eng’ tilyanutikwak ak choronok ago ma nyor inendet. Ko u noto, koweektagei Jerusalem kocheng’ Jesu.

Ki yeit Jerusalem konyor ko mi ak konetik. Ki teebei Jesu teebutik ak kogasei tuguk che mwae konetichuto. Ki kwong’io bik tugul eng’ ng’omnatet ne ki tinyei Jesu. Kilenji anyun Maria Jesu: ‘Lakwani, amu nee si iyaiwech tugun che u chu? Kagearogense ne bo kwong’ut kecheng’in ak kwandang’ung’.’

Kowol Jesu kole: ‘Amu nee si ocheng’a, mongen ole nyolu ami gotab Kwandanyu?’

Chamei Jesu komi ole imuch konetgei agobo Kamuktaindet. Tos ma nyolu keegu bik che u Jesu ak achek? Kingomi Jesu olinnywa Nasaret, ko kicham kwendi tuiyosiek kila wigit kootei Kamuktaindet. Amu ki chi ne ki epchin it tuguk che kineti eng’ tuiyosiechoto, ko ki igochi noto konai tuguk che chang’ che bunu Bibilia. Ongeegu anyun bik che u Jesu ak kisub kakwoutikyik.Luka 2:41-52; Matayo 13:53-56. Teebutik che Kineetengei

KEER cheptuget konyonjin metitab chichi igeere eng’ pichait. Chichito ko Jesu ago eng’ yu ko tinyei kenyisiek che negit 30. Chito ne mi tuwai ko Johana. Kiga kinetgei agobo inendet. Ta ibwati korutechin Maria tilyennyi ne kiguure Elisabet ak koureren lakwet ne ki mi moetab Elisabet? Lakwanoto ki tomo kesich ko ki Johana. Ara anyun, yae nee Johana ak Jesu eng’ yu?

Kagobatisan Johana Jesu eng’ Ainetab Jordan. Kanam Johana Jesu ak korookto anan kochambuldo kochut beek orit, ye ibata kogonob. Kibatisani chito ko u noto. Kiguure Johana Kabatisanindet amu ibatisani bik. Ara anyun, amu nee si kobatisan Johana Jesu?

Kiibatisan Johana Jesu amu kigasom Jesu kibatisan. Ibatisani bik Johana che sigu eng’ tuguk che yaach che kigoyai. Nga u noto, ko tos kiga koyai Jesu kiy age tugul ne ya? Ololo, achicha ma yai amu inendet ko Weritab Kamuktaindet. Ko u noto, ko kisom Jesu Johana kobatisan amu ki mi amu nee age ne teer. Ngegeer amu nee.

Kotomo konyo Jesu kibatisan ko ki yae boisietab bagoinik. Chito ne yae boisionito ko chobei tugun che u mesosiek, ng’echerok ak tuguk alak che kichobee bagoinik. Ki yae boisionito Josep ago kiinet Jesu koyai agine. Nga u noto, ko ki ma iyook Jehovah Werinnyi konyo koek chito ne yae boisietab bagoinik eng’ ng’ony. Mi boisiet ne bo kamanut ne machei Jehovah Jesu koyai ago kagoit kasarta ne magat konaam boisionoto. Ko u noto, ko si koboor kole kinyo ng’ony koyai magetab Kwandanyi, kolenji Johana kobatisan. Tos kiboibochi Kamuktaindet kabatisanennyi? Ee kiboibochi, amu kingolang’u Jesu eng’ beek ko kagibatisan, kogas sautit eng’ kipsengwet ne kimwa kole: ‘Ni ko Werinnyu, ne achame mising’.’ Kitook kora ko u yo kayatak kipsengwet ak konyonji Jesu cheptugoni igeere eng’ pichait. Nga u noto, ko ki ma ko cheptuget, ki kergei ak cheptuget kityo. Eng’ iman ko ki tamirmiriet ne tilil ne bo Kamuktaindet.

Nguni, ko tinyei Jesu tuguk che chang’ che nyolu kobwat, ki wo anyun ole ma mi chi betusiek 40. Kingo ta komi Jesu oloto, konyonji Setani ak kotiem inendet konyil somok koyai tuguk che manamegei ak ng’atutikab Kamuktaindet. Nga u noto, ko kiesio Jesu.

Ki ye ibata, koweek Jesu ago kituiyo ak bik che kibwa koek kasubikyik che tai anan alamalaik. Kainaikwak ko Andrea, Petero (ne kiguure kora Simon), Pilipu ak Natanael (ne kiguure kora Bartolamayo). Ki ba Jesu ak alamalaichuto agoi Galilaya. Kingoit Galilaya komuung’so eng’ Kana, noto ko nganaset ne ki menyei Natanael. Kiwo Jesu eng’ yoto igorto ne bo katunisiet ak koyai kwong’utiennyi ne tai. Tos ingen ile kiyai nee? Ki wal beek koek divaik.Matayo 3:13-17; 4:1-11; 13:55; Mariko 6:3; Johana 1:29-51; 2:1-12. Teebutik che Kineetengei

TOOGU Jesu ko neregat eng’ pichaini, tos ma iman? Tos ingen amu nee si konerech? Nerechi amu bichu mi hekalutab Kamuktaindet eng’ Jerusalem ko tinyei keiyandit anan ko chemoetinik ne bo kwong’ut. Tiemei konyor rabinik che chang’ eng’ bik che bwanei kosae Kamuktaindet eng’ yuto.

Tos igeere eik ak kechirek ak cheptugonik che mi pichaini? Aldoi bichu kiagichu eng’ hekalut. Tos ingen amu nee? Amu machei bik che bwanei hekalut kiagik ak taritik che igochin Jehovah koek tiseiywek.

Ki mwae ng’atutikab Jehovah kole chito ne kayai tengek ko nyolu kogochi Jehovah tiseiywot. Ki mi kora kasarwek che ki nyolu kogoito Israelik tiseiywek. Nga u noto, ko ki ta nyorunee ano taritik ak kiagik che igochin Jehovah?

Mi Israelik che ki bae taritik ak kiagik si kobiit kogoito koek tiseiywek. Nga u noto, ko ki ma kotinyei che chang’ kiagik anan ko taritik. Ki menyei alak ole loo eng’ Jerusalem ko u noto, ko ki ma komuchi koib tiseiywekwak agoi Jerusalem. Ki bwanei bik anyun agoi yuto si koal kiagik ak taritik che makyingei. Nga u noto, ko ki yaachei bichu bik rabinik che chang’ ago ki ng’alei bik. Agot nga u noto, ko ki ma ko magat koaldois eng’ hekalutab Jehovah.

Ki yai nito konerech Jesu. Ki nam anyun mesosiekab bichu ak kogabui ak koserta silingisiekwak. Ki chob kipcharitit ak koon kiagik tugul eng’ hekalut. Kilenji bik che ki aldoi cheptugenik: ‘Omaande tuguchu eng’ yu! Mat oyai gotab Kwandanyu koek ole kiyaen mung’aret.’

Ki kwong’io kasubikab Jesu che ki mi ak Jesu hekalut kingogeer tuguk che ki yai inendet. Ki yai nito kobwat ole mwae eng’ Bibilia agobo Weritab Kamuktaindet kole: ‘Tun lalei chamnyet ne ting’ee gotab Kamuktaindet ko u mat ne lalei.’

Ki yai kwong’utik che chang’ Jesu kingomi igortab Paska eng’ Jerusalem. Ki ye ibata, komanda Jesu eng’ Judea ak konaam koweektagei Galili. Kingo wendi, kobun distrikitab Samaria. Ngegeer kit ne ki yaak eng’ yoto.Johana 2:13-25; 4:3, 4. Teebutik che Kineetengei

data.titulo: Kotuiytos Jesu ak Kwony eng’ Ainet
data.contenido:
IMUUNYI Jesu eng’ tabanutab keringetab beek ne mi Samaria, ago kaba alamalaikyik koal amitwogik. Kwonyi igeere kong’alali ak Jesu, ko kanyonei koibei beek. Kolenji Jesu kwonyi: ‘Inaga beek.’

Kokwong’ anyun kwonyi ne bo kwong’ut. Tos ingen amu nee? Amu Jesu ko Yahudiot ago kwonyi ko bo Samaria. Ma chamei Yahudik che chang’ bikab Samaria, ago ma ng’alaljin agot! Nga u noto, ko chamei Jesu bik tugul. Kolenji anyun Jesu kwonyi: ‘Ndo ingen ile ng’o ne somin beek, ko ka ta isome kogonin beekab sobon.’

Kolenji kwonyoto Jesu: ‘Kiptaiyandani, loo keringet ago metinye agot kit ne kiramee anan ne kisiile beek, ara inyorjini ano beechoto bo sobon?’

Kolenji Jesu: ‘Ngot iee beekab keringoni koamin melelda kogeny, nga u noto, ko beek che agonu komuchi koyai chi komeng’is koigeny.’

Kolenji kwonyoto Jesu: ‘Kiptaiyat, inaga beechoto si ma koaman melel kogeny ago si ma anyone aibe beek eng’ yu kogeny.’

Ibwati kwonyi kole ng’alalee Jesu beek. Nga u noto, ko beek che ng’alalee Jesu, ko imanit agobo Kamuktaindet ak bounatennyin. Imanit ne ng’alalee Jesu ko u beek che konu sobet, imuchi kotoret chito konyor sobondab koigeny.

Kilenji Jesu kwonyoto anyun: ‘Ui kuur boiyondeng’ung’ ak obwa yu.’

Kowol kole: ‘Ma tinye boiyot.’

Kolenji Jesu: ‘Kewolu komie, amu kiotebii ak boisiek mut, ago chito ne omi tuwai nguni ko ma boiyondeng’ung’.’

Ko kwong’ anyun kwonyoto amu iman ng’alechu tugul. Tos ki naita ano Jesu tuguchu tugul? Ki nai amu Jesu ko Ne Kiga Kimwa kele iyoogu Kamuktaindet, ko u noto ko Kamuktaindet ne ki mwachin tuguchu tugul. Kiit alamalaik sainoto ago ki kwong’io kingo keer Jesu kong’alaljin kwondab Samaria.

Tos ineteech nee nito? Ibooru kole chamei Jesu bik tugul ago nyolu keyai ko u noto ak achek. Ma nyolu kibwat kele yaach bik alak amu bunu komosta age kityo. Machei Jesu konai bik tugul imanit ne toreti konyor sobondab koigeny. Kimache ak echek ketoret bik konai imanit.Johana 4:5-43; 17:3. Teebutik che Kineetengei

TOS igeere Jesu eng’ pichaini? Ineti bichu tugul eng’ tulwoni mi Galili. Bichu tebyei ng’ony ago karikyi Jesu, ko alamalaikyik. Kogolewen alamalaik 12 koek che kiyooktoi. Alamalaichuto kiguure che kiyooktoi, ko alamalaikab Jesu che bo kamanut. Tos ingen kainaikwak?

Mi ne keguure Simon Petero ak ne tupcho ne kiguure Andrea, si komi che tupcho che keguure Jakobo ak Johana. Mi age ne keguure Jakobo kora ago mi age ne keguure Simon kora. Alamalaik aeng’ keguure Judas, agenge ko Judas Iskariot, ko age ko Judas Tadayo. Alamalaik alak ang’wan keguure Pilipu, Natanael (ne kiguure kora Bartolamayo), Matayo ak Tomas.

Kingo kagomong’ Jesu eng’ Samaria, kotaunee amdaennyi kole: ‘Negit bounatetab kipsengwet.’ Tos ingen bounatanoto ile nee? bounatanoto ko laitornatetab Kamuktaindet, ago laitoriatab bounatonoto ko Jesu. Tun bounisiei komi kipsengwet ak koibu kalyet konyo ng’ony. Tun yae bounatetab Kamuktaindet ng’ony tugul koek paradiso.

Eng’ yu, koneti Jesu bik agobo bounatetab Kamuktaindet. Ineti kole: ‘Nyolu osa ko u ni, Kwandanyo ne mi kipsengwet, ingotililit kaineng’ung’. Ingonyo bounateng’ung’. Ingoyaak mageng’ung’ eng’ ng’ony, ko u ye yaaksei eng’ kipsengwet.’ Kuree bik che chang’ saanito ‘Saetab Kiptaiyat.’ Tos imwa saanito tugul? Ineti Jesu bik kora agobo ole nyolu kotebto anan kobuurto ak bik alak. Ki inet kole: ‘Oyachi bik alak ko u ye omache koyaiywok.’ Tos ma i baibai yon kayaun bik alak tuguk eng’ oret ne mie? Ko u noto, komwae Jesu kole nyolu keyachi bik alak eng’ oret ne mie. Tun kararan ne tia eng’ ng’onyut ne paradiso koyaei bik tugul ko u noto, tos ma iman?Matayo kurgetab 5 agoi 7; 10:1-4. Teebutik che Kineetengei

LAKWANI igeere eng’ pichait ko bo kenyisiek 12. Kanam Jesu eunnyi, ago chu tonondos eng’ yuto, ko sigikyik. Tos ingen amu nee si koboiboi mising’? Ngegeer.

Kwandab lakwani, ko chi ne bo kamanut ne kiguure Jairo. Mi betut ne ki mian lakwani. Ki mian mising’, ago ma kaigait. Ki arogenso Jairo ak kwondanyin ne bo kwong’ut, amu kitoogu ko u yo tos me lakwennywa. Ki ma kotinyei lakwet age bichoto kobaate nito kityo. Ki wo anyun Jairo kocheng’ Jesu, amu kiga kogas kwong’utik che ki yae Jesu.

Kingo nyoru Jairo Jesu, ko ki mi kwenutab bik che chang’. Nga u noto, kobun Jairo kwenunnywa ak kobutyi kelyekab Jesu. Kosom Jairo Jesu kole: ‘Miani cheptanyun ne bo kwong’ut. Kaigai nyo inyoiwo.’ Koyan Jesu kwo kosoob.

Ki chiilegei bik eng’ oret kotiemei korikyi Jesu kingobendi. Kotonon Jesu ak koteeb kole: ‘Ng’o ne katiinyon?’ Ki teeb Jesu ko u noto amu ki kas koga manda kimnatennyi, konai kole mi chi ne katiiny. Ara anyun ki ng’o ne ki katiiny Jesu? Ki kwony ne kiga komian ne bo kwong’ut kenyisiek 12. Kinyo ak kotiiny ngoroikab Jesu ago ki sob eng’ miandonyi!

Ki yai nito kobaibait Jairo, amu kigeer kole nyumnyum eng’ Jesu kosoob chi. Kiit anyun sainoto chi ne kiga kiyook ak kolenji Jairo: ‘Mata ta iim Jesu, amu kagome cheptang’ung’.’ Ki kas Jesu ng’alechoto ak kolenji Jairo: ‘Meiimgei, mieitu cheptang’ung’.’

Kingoit anyun gotab Jairo, konyor bik korirtos eng’ ng’wanindo. Nga u noto, kolenji Jesu bichoto: ‘Mat oririe. Ma me lakwet, ruei.’ Kororechi bichoto Jesu amu kiingen kole kagome lakwet.

Ki nam anyun Jesu kwanda ak kametab lakwet koboto alamalaikyik somok che kiyooktoi, ak komut ko ba rumit ne ki mi lakwet. Konam Jesu eutab lakwet ak kolenji: ‘Ng’eet!’ Kong’eet lakwet ko u ye igeere eng’ pichait. Noto amu nee si igeere koboiboi ne bo kwong’ut kamet ak kwandanyin.

Ma ne tai lakwanito kong’eet Jesu eng’ meet. Chito ne tai ne ng’alalee Bibilia ko weritab mosoget ne ki menyei nganasetab Nain. Kiing’eet Jesu kora Lasaro ne tupcho ak Maria ak Marta. Tun ing’eeti Jesu bik che chang’ che ki kobeg ye laitoran eng’ bounatetab Kamuktaindet. Tos ma nyolu keboibochi nito?Luka 8:40-56; 7:11-17; Johana 11:17-44. Teebutik che Kineetengei

KAGOYAAK kit ne ya ne bo kwong’ut. Kagebar Johana Kabatisanindet. Ki ma ko machei kwondab laitoriat ne kiguure Herodia Johana, kolenji anyun laitoriat kotil metitab Johana.

Kingo kas ng’alechoto Jesu koimgei ne bo kwong’ut ak kwo ole ma mi chi. Nga u noto, ko kiisub bik. Kingo keer Jesu bichoto, koriree. Kong’alalji anyun agobo bounatetab Kamuktaindet ak kosoob che miandos.

Koskoleng’unoto kobwanji alamalaikyik ak kolenji: ‘Ka koimen, ago ma mi chi yu. Chamji bik koba koaljigei amitwogik eng’ kokwatinwek che negiten.’

Kowol Jesu kole: ‘Mat ko ba. Ogochi kiy ne ame.’ Koteebe Jesu Pilipu kole: ‘Kialen ano amitwogik che yamei kebaee bichu tugul?’

Kowolji Pilipu Jesu kole: ‘Yaachei keboisie rabinik che chang’ keal amitwogik che imuchi konyor chi tugul tutigin.’ Kole Andrea: ‘Tinyei lakwani ibwech amitwogik magatinik mut ak samaginik aeng’. Nga u noto, ko magoi yam bichu tugul.’

Kole Jesu: ‘Olenji bik koteb ng’ony.’ Ki sa anyun Jesu koweekyi Kamuktaindet kongoi eng’ amitwogik ak kopcheapchei. Ye ibata, konaam alamalaikyik koropchi bik tugul magatiat ak samakiat. Ki mi murenik 5,000 ak kwonyik ak lagok che chang’. Ki amis anyun bik tugul kot kobiyong’so ago ki ng’et amitwogik che kanyi kigabusiek 12!

Kolenji Jesu alamalaikyik kolaany melit ak koba kobun Araraitab Galili. Kingo ta kobendi eng’ araraita kemoi, konyo usonet anan koristo ne o ak kotumdum melit kwo komosi ak komosi. Koarogenso ne bo kwong’ut alamalaik. Kingo mi kemboi kwen, kogeer kiy ne bunu beek barak ak konyonei kotakyingei icheget. Kowaakyo eng’ arogenet amu ma nai kole ki nee ne kigeerei.

Kole Jesu: ‘Mat oarogense amu ane ni!’ Ma iyan alamalaik. Kole Petero anyun: ‘Kiptaiyat, ngot ko inye eng’ iman, ilenjon anyonjin abun beek barak.’ Kolenji Jesu: ‘Nyo!’ Ki mong’ Petero eng’ melit ak kwo kobun beek barak! Kingo ta kwendi koarogen ak konaam ko chut beek orit, kingogeer Jesu ko u noto kosor inendet.

Ki tun kobai kora Jesu bik elfusiek che chang’. Kasarito ko ki bae bik magatinik tisab ak samakinik tutigin che ki mengech ago ki yam amitwogik bik tugul. Tos ma bo kwong’ut ole ribtoi bik Jesu? Ye tun laitoran Jesu eng’ bounatetab Jehovah ko tun ko ma ko mi kiy age tugul ne iimech!Matayo 14:1-32; 15:29-38; Johana 6:1-21. Teebutik che Kineetengei

IGEERE Jesu eng’ pichait ko kanam lakwet? Ibooru nito kole chamei Jesu lagok che mengechen. Bichu keerei Jesu ko alamalaikyik che kiyooktoi. Tos mwachin nee Jesu alamalaikyik? Ngegeer.

Bunu Jesu ak alamalaikyik rutoito ne loo. Kingo bwanei eng’ oret, ko ki tiiytos anan ki ng’ichegei alamalaikyik. Kingoit ole ki bendi koteebe Jesu anyun alamalaik kole: ‘Amu nee si ko tiiytosi eng’ oret?’ Eng’ iman ko ki ingen Jesu amu nee si kong’ichgei alamalaikyik, nga u noto ko ki teeb si kobiit kogeer ngot ko tos mwachi.

Ma wol alamalaik amu ki tiiytos ko machei konai kole ng’o ne o eng’ ichek. Ki machei alamalaik alage eng’ ichek koek che bo kamanut mising’ kosiir alak. Ara anyun mwachindoi ano Jesu alamalaikyik kole ma nyolu komach chi koek ne o eng’ bik alak?

Ki kuur anyun Jesu lakwet ne mining’ konyo taitab alamalaikyik ak kolenji: ‘Amache onai ole, ngot ko mowalage ak oegu bik che u lagok, ko monyoru bounatetab Kamuktaindet. Chito ne o eng’ bounatetab Kamuktaindet ko chito ne u lakwani.’ Tos ingen amu nee si komwa Jesu ko u noto?

Eng’ iman, ko ma magen kiy lagok che mengech koek che bik eech anan ko che bo kamanut kosiir alak. Ko u noto, ko nyolu konetgei alamalaik koek bik che u lagok, ma nyolu koboljigei kole ng’o ne o anan ne bo kamanut kosiir age.

Mi kasarwek alak kora che kiiboor Jesu kole chamei lagok che mengechen. Kingobata arawek tutigin, komut bik lagokwak kobwa kogeer Jesu. Ki tiem alamalaik kogirinda lagochoto. Nga u noto kolenji Jesu alamalaikyik: ‘Omete lagok kobwanjon, mat ogirinde amu bo bounatetab Kamuktaindet bik che u chuto.’ Koganab anyun Jesu lagok ak koberur. Mie ne tia kenai kele chamei Jesu lagok che mengech, tos ma iman?Matayo 18:1-4; 19:13-15; Mariko 9:33-37; 10:13-16. Teebutik che Kineetengei

KI LENJI Jesu chito age besio nyolu kocham chitab kokwennyi. Koteebe chichoto kole: ‘Chitab kokwennyu ko ng’o?’ Kiingen Jesu kit ne kiibwati chichoto, kiibwati kole bikab kokwennyi, ko che bunu komosta ne bunu inendet ak che bo dininnyin kityo. Ngegeer anyun kit ne mwachin Jesu chichito.

Mi kasarwek che ki boisiee Jesu atindonik konetis, ago nito kit ne yae nguno. Kimwa atindiot agobo Yahudiot ak Samarindet. Koginetgei kele ki ma ko chamei Yahudik che chang’ bik che bunu Samaria. Atindoniotab Jesu ko ni:

Mi Yahudiot ne ki wendi Jeriko besio. Kingo ta kwendi, konam chorik ak korebee robisiekyik ak kobir ne ki ta bar.

Ki bun yoto anyun tisiindetab Yahudik, kogeer chichoto ki kagibir. Tos ingen ile ki yai nee? Ki bun taban ak kotestai ak bandanyi. Konyo kora Lawindet ne ki chi ne bo dini. Tos ki telel kogeer chichi? Achicha, ololo ma telel agine kotoret chichi. Tos igeere tisiindet ak Lawindet eng’ pichait ko kagosiirto?

Ara ng’o chichi igeere eng’ pichait komi ak chichi kagebir? Chichito ko Samarindet ago toreti Yahudiot kondechin kerichek mook. Ye ibata, komut chichito kwo ole kimuchi kinyaen si komieit borto.

Kingotar Jesu komwae atindiondonito, kolenji chito ne kiga teebee teebutiet: ‘Tos ng’o eng’ chuto somok ne ibwati ile kiek chitab kokwet eng’ chichi kigabir magoraek? Tos ki tisiindet, Lawindet anan Samarindet?’

Kowol chichoto kole: ‘Samarindet amu ki yachi chichoto kiga kibir ne mie.’

Komwa Jesu kole: ‘Kewolu komie. Ko u noto iwe ak iyachi bik alak tuguk che miach ko u Samarindonoto.’

Tos mechame oret ne boisiee Jesu konetis? Kimuchi kinetgei tuguk che chang’ che bo kamanut ngot kegas it tuguk che mwaei Jesu eng’ Bibilia.Luka 10:25-37. Teebutik che Kineetengei

KIISOOB Jesu bik che ki miandos eng’ komoswek che ki rutochi. Ki kasak kwong’utichuto eng’ kokwatinwek ak nganasok tugul che ki negiten. Ko u noto, konaam bik komutyi Jesu bik che salamonik, che koriotin, che ma kastoi ak alak che ki miandos, ago kiisoob Jesu bichoto tugul.

Kogosiirto kenyisiek somogu nguno kong’eete ngibatisan Jesu. Ki mwachi anyun Jesu alamalaikyik kolenji wendi Jerusalem konegit, ole ba kebareen ak ye ibata king’eet. Olaan tugul, kosoobi Jesu bik che miandos.

Kiinetisiei Jesu besio eng’ betutab Sabato. Sabato ko betut ne ki imuunyi Yahudik. Kwonyi igeere eng’ yu, ko kigomian ne bo kwong’ut. Eng’ kenyisiek 18, ko ki ma komuchi kotelel komie, kingowendoti ko kiing’urugoti. Ki tiiny anyun Jesu kwonyito eng’ eunnyi, ago kiinaam kotelel ak kosob sainoto!

Koyai nito konerekso kandoikab dini. Komwa agenge eng’ sautit ne o kole: ‘Mi betusiek lou che nyolu keyai boisiet. Chuto betusiek che nyolu kisoob bik, ma betutab Sabato!’

Kowol anyun Jesu kole: ‘Okwek bichu yaach. Age tugul eng’ okwek, kotiachi sigiriennyin ak koget anan kokweri koe beek eng’ betutab Sabato. Ara tos ma nyolu kinya kosob kwonyi kigomian kenyisiek 18 eng’ betutab Sabato?’ Ki yai nito kolilanso bichoto.

Ki ba anyun Jesu ak alamalaikyik che kiyooktoi Jerusalem. Kingo negit kochut nganasetab Jeriko, ko ki mi bik aeng’u che koriotin che ki somsei ago ki kas kole siirtoi Jesu. Komwa eng’ sautit ne o kole: ‘Jesu, toretech!’

Koguur Jesu bichoto koriotin ak koteebe kole: ‘Omache ayaiywok nee?’ Kowol kole: ‘Kiptaiyat, ngoyatogis konyekyok.’ Kotiiny Jesu konyekwak, kogeerto bichoto sainoto! Tos ingen amu nee si koyai Jesu kwong’utichu tugul? Ki yai amu chamei bik ago machei koyan bik inendet. Ko u noto kimuchi kiyan kele, tun ye laitoran Jesu ko ma komi chi ne ta komiani kogeny eng’ ng’ony.Matayo 15:30, 31; Luka 13:10-17; Matayo 20:29-34. Teebutik che Kineetengei

KINGOBATA kasarta kitigin kong’eete ngosoob Jesu bik aeng’ che kigoriotin, kwo kokwet ne ki negite Jerusalem. Kolenji alamalaikyik aeng’: ‘Oba agoi kokwonin. Ye oit, onyoru sigiriet ne kagirat, otiach ak orang’u anan ogetwo.’

Kingoit sigiriet, kotebee Jesu barak ak kobun kwo Jerusalem amu ki ma ko loo Jeruslem eng’ yoto. Kingoriikta Jerusalem, kobwa bik che chang’ che ki torogu. Ki iito bik alak ngoroikwak eng’ oret, kotil alak sosik ak konde oret ak komwa eng’ sautit ne o kole: ‘Ingoberur Kamuktaindet laitoriat ne nyonei eng’ kainetab Jehovah!’

Ki cham kolanyei laitorinik che leelach keny sigiriet ne mining’ ak kobun koba Jerusalem si koboorchigei bik. Nito kit ne yae Jesu nguni, ago ibooru bichu kole machei Jesu koek laitoriandennywa. Nga u noto, ko ma chamei bik tugul Jesu. Ki nae nito eng’ tuguk che ki yaagis kingwo Jesu hekalut.

Kiisoob Jesu bik che ki koriotin ak che ki ma ko kororon kelyek kingomi hekalut. Kingogeer lagok che mengech kwang’utichuto, koloos Jesu. Konerekso tisiik ak kolenji Jesu: ‘Igase kit ne mwae lagok?’

Kowolji Jesu kole: ‘Ee, agase, ki ma osoman eng’ Bibilia ole mwae kole: “Mong’unee kaloosunet kutuswekab lagok che mengechen?”’ Kotestai anyun lagok koloos laitoriat ne kilewen Kamuktaindet.

Kimache kekergeitun ak lagochoto, tos ma iman? Imuchi kotiem bik alak kotereech si ma kimwachi bik alak agobo Bounatetab Kamuktaindet. Nga u noto, keyae ne mie ngot ketestai kemwachi bik alak agobo tuguk che kororon che tun yachin Jesu bik.

Ki tomo koit kasarta ne inaami Jesu kolaitorani kingo ta komi ng’ony. Ki machei alamalaikab Jesu konai kole inaami au. Kinetigei noto eng’ atindoniot ne rubei.Matayo 21:1-17; Johana 12:12-16. Teebutik che Kineetengei

JESU ni igeere eng’ yu komi Tulwetab Emitik, ago bichu mi tugul ko alamalaikyik che kiyooktoi. Alamalaichuto ko Andrea, Petero, Jakobo ak Johana. Ko nin igeere eng’ pichait, ko hekalutab Jehovah ne mi Jerusalem. Kogosiirto betusiek aeng’u kong’eete ngwo Jesu Jerusalem kobunei sigiriet ne ming’in. Raini ko Kasitab Aeng’ anan Kwaeng’ Kasi, ago subui ko ka mi Jesu hekalut ago kango mi yoto, ko katiem tisiik konam komachei kobar. Nga u noto, ko kaiywei amu ingen kole chamei bik Jesu.

Koguure Jesu kandoichoto bo dini: ‘Okwek erenok ak lagokab erenok!’ Ye ibata, kole Jesu tun iruokyin Kamuktaindet kandoichoto bo dini kosubgei ak tuguk che yaach che ki yae. Kingo kagomwa ko u noto Jesu, kwo agoi Tulwetab Emitik ago kiinaam alamalaichu ang’wanu koteebe teebutik eng’ yoto. Tos ingen ile nee ne teebee alamalaichu Jesu?

Teebe alamalaik agobo tuguk che tun yaaksei eng’ betusiek che bwanei. Ingen kole tun igeesu Jesu yaitiet tugul ne mi ng’ony, nga u noto ko machei konai kole tun yaaksei tuguchu au. Ara anyun tun nyonei au Jesu kolaitorani?

Ingen Jesu kole tun ye nyo, ko ma keerei kasubikyik che mi ng’ony, amu tun ko mi kipsengwet inendet. Ki mwachi anyun Jesu alamalaikyik che kiyooktoi tuguk che tun yaaksei eng’ ng’ony ye tun laitorani ko mi kipsengwet. Tos nee tuguchoto?

Kile Jesu tun kobiitu boriosiek che eechen, tun ko miandos bik che chang’ ago tun kobiitu rubet, tun ko tesaksei yaitiet ak tun biitu botanosiekab ng’ony che eechen. Kimwa Jesu kora kole tun keamdaati lagoiywekab bounatetab Kamuktaindet eng’ ng’ony komugul. Tos kigoyaak tuguchu eng’ kasari kimi? Ee! Ko u noto, ko eng’ iman kingen komie kele laitorani Jesu nguni eng’ kipsengwet ago igeesu yaitiet tugul konegit.Matayo 21:46; 23:1-39; 24:1-14; Mariko 13:3-10. Teebutik che Kineetengei

data.titulo: Komi Jesu ak Alamalaikyik Koroba Barak
data.contenido:
KOGOSIIRTO betusiek aengu, ago nguni ko kemoutab Kasitab Ang’wan anan Kwang’wan Kasi. Kabwa Jesu ak alamalaikyik che kiyooktoi 12 rumini mi goroba barak si kobiit koam Paska. Chito ne igeere komandoi eng’ ruminito, ko Judas Iskariot. Wendi komwachin tisiik ole imuchi konamda Jesu.

Kotomo betut agenge koit betunito, ko kogawo Judas koteebe tisiik kole: ‘Ogono nee ngot atoretok onam Jesu?’ Kolenji tisiik: ‘Kigonin fedaisiek sosom.’ Ko u noto, ko wendi nguno Judas konyoru bichuto si kobiit kondochi bichuto konyor Jesu. Tos ma kit ne ya ne bo kwong’ut nito?

Kingobek igoortab Paska, konaam Jesu igoorto age ne bo kamanut. Kiigochi alamalaikyik magatiat ak kolenji: ‘Oam, amu nito kobooru bortonyun ne kigoitoi agobo okwek.’ Kiigochi kora kigombetab divaik ak kolenji: ‘Oee, amu chu kobooru korotikyuk che kitumdoi agobo okwek.’ Kuree Bibilia nito ‘igoortab koskoleny ne bo Kiptaiyat’ anan ko ‘igoortab Kiptaiyat.’

Ki amei Israelik Paska si kobwatyi betut ne ‘kigasiirtoeen’ malakaiyatab Jehovah gorikwak eng’ Misri ak kobar lagok che tai che bo Misrik. Nga u noto, komachei Jesu kobwat kasubikyik agobo inendet ak ole ki konundo sobennyi. Noto amu nee si kolenji koyai igoorito kila kenyit.

Kingobata Igoortab Kosgoleny ne bo Kiptaiyat, kolenji Jesu alamalaikyik konyigonitu ak kogimegitu eng’ kayanet. Eng’ let anyun kotienji Jehovah tienwogik ak koba. Kiga koba saisiek, imuchi agot kiga kosiir sait lo ne bo kemboi. Ngegeer anyun ole bendi.Matayo 26:14-30; Luka 22:1-39; Johana kurgetab 13 agoi 17; 1 Korintoek 11:20. Teebutik che Kineetengei

KINGOMANDA Jesu ak alamalaikyik eng’ gotab koroba, koba agoi ole kiguure Getsemane, mbaret ne kiga kimin ketik che kororon. Kiga kobendi yoto konyil che chang’. Ki yeit yoto, kolenji Jesu alamalaikyik kotestai kosa amat koruiyo, ak kwo inendet ole loo kitigin ak kogutuny kosa.

Tos ingen ile kingoweek Jesu ole ki mi alamalaikyik konyor koyae nee? Ki nyor koruiytos! Ki nyo Jesu konyil somok ole ki mi alamalaikyik kolenji mat koruiyo, nga u noto ko kasarta age tugul ne ki nyo, ko ki nyor koruiytos. Kingonyo ne bo let koteebe kole: ‘Amu nee si oruiye eng’ kasarta ne u ni? Kagoit kasarta ne nyolu kigochon bunikyuk.’

Sainoto, kogas kobwanei bik che chang’. Keer o! Bwanei bik che chang’ che tinyei rotonokab chok, rungusiek ak tochisiek che ikweng’een oret! Kingoriik bichuto, komong’ agenge eng’ kwenunnywa ak kotokyigei ole mi Jesu ak kotoroch Jesu ko u ye igeere eng’ pichait. Chichito keguure Judas Iskariot! Tos amu nee si kotoroch Judas Jesu?

Koteebe Jesu kolenji: ‘Judas, ing’wektoena toroget?’ Eng’ iman, ko ki kaborunet toroganoto. Ki nai anyun bik che ki mi ak Judas Jesu, amu ki cheng’ei Jesu. Kobwa anyun bunikab Jesu ak konam. Nga u noto, ko ma iyan Petero kimut Jesu. Kiichuut rotwetab chok ne ki tinyei ak koeb chito ne ki negitee inendet. Ki ichilil rotwonoto metitab chichoto ak kotil ititab tai! Nga u noto, ko nam Jesu ititab chichoto ak kosoob.

Kolenji Jesu Petero: ‘Weekyi rotwetab chok ole kami. Mengen ile amuchi alenji Kwandanyu koyaakwon malaikaisiek elfusiek kosorwo?’ Eng’ iman komuchi! Nga u noto, ko ma som Jesu Jehovah koyookyi malaikaisiek amu ki ingen kole kiga koit kasarta konam bunikyik. Koyan anyun Jesu kimut. Ngegeer kit ne yaaksei eng’ Jesu.Matayo 26:36-56; Luka 22:39-53; Johana 18:1-12. Teebutik che Kineetengei

TOS igeere kit ne ya ne bo kwong’ut ne kagoyaak eng’ pichaini? Kagigartat Jesu eng’ ketit. Kagibirji kipchumarik eunek ak kelyekyik. Amu nee si keyachi Jesu kit ne ya ne u ni?

Amu mi bik che sasei Jesu. Tos ingen ile ng’o bichoto? Agenge ko Setani ne Oindet. Inendet ne ki yae Adam ak Awa kongelelji Jehovah, ago inendet kora ne kayai bunikab Jesu koyachi ko u ye igeere eng’ pichait.

Agot kotomo kogartat bunik Jesu eng’ ketit, ko kiyachi tuguk che yaach mising’. Ta ibwati ole ki bwanunda agoi mbaretab Getsemane ak komut Jesu? Tos ki ng’o bunichuto? Ki kandoikab dini. Ngegeer anyun kit ne ki yaak.

Kingomut kandoikab dini Jesu, koarogenso alamalaik ak korwai, kometochi Jesu bunik. Nga u noto, ko ma ba ole loo Petero ak Johana. Ki isub si kogeer kit ne itoi bunichoto Jesu.

Komutyi anyun tisiik Jesu boiyot ne kiguure Anas ne ki cham ko tisiindet ne o. Ma tebi eng’ yoto koek keny. Kingomanda eng’ yoto komut Jesu kwo gotab tisiindet ne o ne kiguure Kaiapa. Ki kabwa kandoikab dini che chang’ goyoto.

Ki kiruokyi anyun Jesu eng’ gotab Kaiapa. Kibwa bik ak komwa lembechek agobo Jesu. Komwa kandoikab dini tugul kole: ‘Nyolu kebar Jesu.’ Ki sing’ilji toget kora ak koluch.

Kingo tesetai tuguchu tugul ko ki mi Petero ole kiga kilaal mat eng’ sang’ anan bii amu ki kaitit. Kingo ta koyuei mat, kogeer chepto agenge Petero ak komwa kole: ‘Cham komi chichi ak Jesu agine.’

Kowol Petero kole: ‘Achicha, ko ma kemi tuwai.’

Kimwa bik konyil somok kole kimi Petero ak Jesu, nga u noto, ko ki esio Petero tugul kole ma iman. Kingoesio ne bo somok, kogusyi kong’ Jesu Petero. Kiimgei Petero amu kimwa lembech, ki wo anyun ak korir.

Ki ye eech Komut Kasi, komut tisiik Jesu kwo tuiyet ne o ne kiguure Sanhedrin. Ki king’alale eng’ yoto kit ne kiitoi Jesu. Ki ye ibata, kimutyi Jesu laitoriat ne bo Judea ne kiguure Pilato.

Kilenji tisiik Pilato: ‘Ya chichi, magat kebar.’ Koteebe Pilato Jesu teebutik, ye ibata kole: ‘Mageere kit ne ya ne kayai chichi.’ Ki ye ibata, komwa Pilato kole nyolu kimutyi Jesu Herod Antipa. Herod ko laitoriatab Galili nganda menyei Jerusalem. Ma nyorji Herod lelut Jesu kora, ko u noto kole keweekyi Pilato.

Ki machei Pilato kityach Jesu, nga u noto, ko kimach bunikab Jesu kityach chito age ne kigagirat ne ki chorindet ne kiguure Baraba. Nguno ko negit koit sait lo ne bo beet. Komoong’ anyun Pilato Jesu ak kolenji bik: ‘Ogeer! Laitoriandeng’wong’! Kowookyo tisiik kole: ‘Obar! Obar!’ Kiityach anyun Pilato Baraba ak koyan kimut Jesu keba kebar.

Saisiek tutigin ko kagosiir bet kwen eng’ betutab Kasitab Mut, kigartat Jesu eng’ ketit. Ki kigartat Jesu ak magoraek aeng’, nganda matoogu eng’ pichait. Kingo tomo kome Jesu kolenji magoraiyat agenge: ‘Tun ibwata eng’ bounateng’ung’.’ Kowolji Jesu kole: ‘Amwaun ale tun kemi tuwai Paradiso.’

Kororon ne tia ng’alechu! Tos ingen ile ki ng’alaleen Jesu paradiso ainon anan ngoro? Ki mi ano paradiso ne ki kayai Kamuktaindet eng’ tai? Ki mi ng’ony. Tun ye laitoran Jesu komi kipsengwet, ko tun kong’eeti chichoto si koboibochi sobet eng’ ng’ony ne Paradiso. Tos ma iboiboech nito?Matayo 26:57-75; 27:1-50; Luka 22:54-71; 23:1-49; Johana 18:12-40; 19:1-30. Teebutik che Kineetengei
